classes.name: Cinder Warden
classes.pitch: Stand in the pack and outlast it.
classes.blurb: A sentinel who brands steel with fire. Slow to start, hard to put down, and stronger once the fire skills come in.

classes.name: Reed Caller
classes.pitch: Call glasslings, then shoot from behind them.
classes.blurb: A ranged binder who calls glasslings out of still water. Frail in a straight fight, dangerous once the chorus is up.

classes.name: Briar Stalker
classes.pitch: Lay the snares. Let the poison do the work.
classes.blurb: A knife and a patient snare. You stay out of the thick of it, you don't keep a chorus, and you leave poison in the ground.

classes.name: Salt Reaver
classes.pitch: Step through the pack and take a little life back.
classes.blurb: A fast blade that lives in arm's reach. You step through a pack, you cut on the way, and you take a little life back with you.

classes.name: Bell Chanter
classes.pitch: Ring the room with lightning, then slow the enemies in it.
classes.blurb: You deal lightning in a ring and slow the room with hymns. You don't call a chorus of glass. You use a bell, a hymn, and whoever is already beside you.

branches.name: Brand
branches.about: Close cuts that also deal fire.

branches.name: Ember
branches.about: Sparks, wards, and the bloom that clears a pack.

branches.name: Warden
branches.about: Armor, life steal, and Last Coal, which can save you from a killing blow.

branches.name: Call
branches.about: Servants pulled out of glass and salt.

branches.name: Tide
branches.about: Cold bolts and a ring of ice that hits everything around you.

branches.name: Bond
branches.about: Skills that keep you and your servants alive, and Last Reed, which can save you from a killing blow.

branches.name: Snare
branches.about: Snares left in the path, and a skill that sets them all off.

branches.name: Venom
branches.about: A needle, a poison cloud, and poison that lasts.

branches.name: Hide
branches.about: Faster movement, a coat that poisons attackers, and Last Briar, which can save you from a killing blow.

branches.name: Edge
branches.about: Short cuts and the step that puts you through a pack.

branches.name: Tempo
branches.about: Attack speed, a spinning cut, and moving first.

branches.name: Vein
branches.about: Life stolen from your cuts, and Last Salt, which can save you from a killing blow.

branches.name: Bell
branches.about: A note, a peal, and the shock that follows.

branches.name: Hymn
branches.about: Songs that slow a room and raise your armor.

branches.name: Keep
branches.about: Mana and staying power, and Last Bell, which can save you from a killing blow.

balanceSim.notes: DPS is auto-attack plus the primary skill on cooldown (and a rank-1 glassling for Reed Caller). eHP is time-to-die versus a standard pack of 4 bramble hounds at the hero's character level. Product is DPS times TTD. Caster Energy adds to the existing edmg (enhancedDamage) sheet stat instead of armor defense. The L50+P100 row also applies 100 Paragon levels: 5 spendable stat points each (same 2/2/1 spend as a hero level), +2 flat life per Paragon level, and 20 extra skill points that do not raise a already-maxed primary.
